+                    # avoids a single unnaturally long mark across the canvas.

+    # treated as opaque.

+        best_i, best_score = -1, -1e30
+        for i, c in enumerate(cands):
+            if not live[i]: continue
+            color, p0, p1, pix = c
+            score = float(np.sum(state_loss[pix] - dist[color, pix]))
+            if score > best_score:
